shared_elements: motif carved on an upright slab surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow, schematic carved designs built from angular, stepped elements attached to a curving contour, and in each a profile creature-like head with an open jaw can plausibly be read (the serpentine head at the base of A, the terminal of the arcing motif in B). The decisive difference is that A depicts a full standing anthropomorphic figure with elaborate headdress occupying the whole panel above a densely filled register of signs, whereas B shows only a single isolated arcing motif on an otherwise blank field, so the compositional programmes have essentially nothing specific in common.
